summary: Candidate is a distinct Spring Boot 3.0 migration micro-skill addressing constructor parameter annotation in @ConfigurationProperties classes. It has no semantic overlap with existing skills (Mooncake P2P checkpoint distribution and ProcessPoolExecutor lifecycle configuration are unrelated domains). Peer candidates are also distinct Spring Boot 3.0 migration tasks with different objectives (banner format, Maven plugin deprecation, HTTP header properties). Candidate has valid support evidence from Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide and represents a novel, actionable capability.
